ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Binary Or Script Dropper Via PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell creating a binary executable or a script file.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.chm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.cmd$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.com$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.jar$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.js$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ocx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.scr$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.sys$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.wsf$"))) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$"))) OR ((file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SystemTemp\\\\")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$"))) OR (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\Modules\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$")) OR (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PackageManagement\\\\ProviderAssemblies\\\\nuget\\\\") AND file_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\.PackageManagement\\\.NuGetProvider\\\.dll$")))
